title: Smooth Lie-group infrastructure for the intrinsic Spin group
exact_missing_structure: A smooth manifold structure on SpinCore.SpinGroup, its exponential map, and a smooth structure on GLor compatible with spinCover. (An intrinsic Lorentz-skew Lie algebra gB/gBLie already exists, CLAIM-L011; what is missing here is the smooth/Lie-group package of the Spin side, not a Lie algebra.)
current_boundary: SpinGroup and GLor are certified as Hausdorff topological groups with continuous local sections of spinCover; nothing smooth exists. The certified infinitesimal object of the project is the Lorentz-side gB.
why_not_proved: Building a Lie-group package for a subgroup of the units of a Clifford algebra requires a submanifold construction that the project has not developed, and the pinned Mathlib does not supply it for this group.
prerequisites: a chart construction around the identity
suggested_next_test: Prove that the Spin-side Cech gauge of the smoke test is C-infinity, which currently can only be stated on the projected side.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not call the Spin cocycle gauge smooth on the strength of the projected-side result, and do not claim that the existing gB is Lie(SpinGroup).

title: The connection layer
exact_missing_structure: Local Spin-side transport one-forms on each patch, valued in an intrinsic infinitesimal generator space, together with the overlap transformation law derived from the project's own Cech convention.
current_boundary: The project has transition cocycles and solders, but no object that differentiates a section.
why_not_proved: The generator space requires OP-012 (the infinitesimal Spin bridge) or an explicit exponential-free substitute; the transformation law must be derived from the fixed Cech convention, not chosen by analogy.
prerequisites: OP-001 or an explicit paravector-generator substitute
suggested_next_test: Repeat the Task-38 smoke test one layer down: is there a one-parameter family of transport one-forms that is not gauge equivalent at the level of the overlap law?
forbidden_shortcut: Do not introduce an independent Lorentz-side one-form; it must be induced through the differential of the native Spin cover or a proved equivalent infinitesimal representation. The group-level spinCover must not be applied to a Lie-algebra-valued one-form (CLAIM-B011).

title: Parallel transport
exact_missing_structure: Solutions of the transport equation along paths in a chart, and their chart independence under the overlap law of OP-002.
why_not_proved: Requires OP-002 and an ODE existence result at the required generality; on the periodic control an explicit one-dimensional solution would suffice.
suggested_next_test: Loop transport around the wrap-around component of the frozen periodic model.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not define transport by a formula chosen to produce a desired invariant.

title: Holonomy
exact_missing_structure: A loop-transport functional and its conjugation behaviour under gauge.
suggested_next_test: Compare the holonomy of the deformed and undeformed families on the control.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not identify a nontrivial holonomy with curvature without a field strength.

title: Curvature
exact_missing_structure: A field strength F = d omega + omega wedge omega, its gauge covariance, and its transport to the tangent side through the solder.
current_boundary: Absent; the deformation firewall forbids even naming such an object in the deformation branch.
suggested_next_test: Compute, never target, the field strength of an admissible transport family.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not read the Task-38 parameter as a curvature, and do not read its sign as a curvature sign.

title: Comparison with the standard characteristic classes
exact_missing_structure: A formal comparison of the project-native fixed-cover orientation and Spin obstructions with w1(TM) and w2(TM).
current_boundary: The project proves project-native orientation compatibility and triviality of a project-native kernel-valued class.
why_not_proved: The pinned Mathlib has no Stiefel-Whitney classes and no H^2(M; Z/2) for these spaces, and the project has not built them.
prerequisites: a Cech-to-singular comparison for the emergent manifold
characteristic classes in the pinned library
suggested_next_test: Construct the classical Cech class of the frame bundle and compare it with the native class on a control model.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not state that w1(TM) = w2(TM) = 0 has been proved.

title: Generality beyond the fixed control model
exact_missing_structure: A version of the Task-38/39 smoke test for base gluings other than the frozen periodic control, and for co-varying bases (MAIN TEST B).
current_boundary: All smoke-test statements are about loopGluingOf kappa LoopTwist.id' and the family loopSharedSpin.
why_not_proved: The constructions use the coordinate gap between the two incidence components of this control; covers without such room are not covered by the argument.
prerequisites: a second control geometry with a different incidence pattern
suggested_next_test: Re-run the admissibility and gauge tests on a cover whose overlaps leave no interpolation room.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not generalize the pure-gauge conclusion to arbitrary transition deformations.

title: Full solder-solution comparison beyond the tested control
exact_missing_structure: A transport of regular solder solutions along a gauge transformation for a general base gluing and a general gauge.
current_boundary: Task 39 proves the transport, the bijection of solution spaces and the metric preservation for the frozen periodic control only.
why_not_proved: A general statement needs a general notion of a smooth projected gauge; on the control it is available because the gauge has an explicit closed form.
suggested_next_test: State and prove the transport for an abstract smooth projected gauge datum and check that the control instantiates it.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not present the control-specific correspondence as a general theorem.

title: Topological identification of the control model
exact_missing_structure: A proof that the emergent base of the periodic control is homeomorphic to S^1 x R^3, or any statement about its fundamental group.
current_boundary: Only the two-component periodic overlap pattern of the fixed cover is proved and used.
why_not_proved: Fundamental-group and product-space infrastructure for quotient constructions has not been built in this project.
suggested_next_test: Construct the homeomorphism explicitly for the one-loop model.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not describe the control as a proved circle model in any manuscript.

title: Time orientability in the standard sense
exact_missing_structure: A theorem relating the project-native future-cone reduction to standard time-orientability of a Lorentzian manifold.
current_boundary: The reduction is a coherent chartwise cone choice.
why_not_proved: The project has no Lorentzian-manifold structure in Mathlib's sense to compare with.
prerequisites: a bridge to a Mathlib Lorentzian structure
suggested_next_test: Show that the glued reduction of the control induces a global timelike vector field.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not state that the emergent manifold is time orientable in the standard sense.

title: Existence theory for the regular solder
exact_missing_structure: Sufficient conditions on a base gluing and a native Spin datum under which a regular solder exists.
current_boundary: Existence is constructed for explicit controls and provably fails for the Moebius-type control.
why_not_proved: No general construction is available; the two known gates are necessary conditions only.
prerequisites: a partition-of-unity or obstruction-theoretic argument in the project's own setting
suggested_next_test: Decide whether the two certified gates are jointly sufficient on a small family of control models.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not assume the gates are sufficient; only necessity is proved.

title: The infinitesimal Spin bridge: relate the existing Lorentz-skew Lie algebra to the intrinsic SpinGroup
exact_missing_structure: An identification of the infinitesimal structure of the intrinsic SpinCore.SpinGroup with the existing Lorentz-skew Lie algebra gB / gBLie -- either a genuine Lie(SpinGroup) with a proved equivalence Lie(SpinGroup) =~ gB, or an explicitly proved project-native substitute -- together with the differential of the native cover d-rho-e : Lie(SpinGroup) -> gB, or an explicitly proved equivalent infinitesimal representation.
current_boundary: CERTIFIED: gB / gBLie exists, is six-dimensional, has the commutator bracket and is linearly equivalent to the bivector space of the intrinsic carrier (CLAIM-L011). NOT CERTIFIED: any infinitesimal object attached to SpinGroup, any equivalence with gB, and any differential of spinCover (CLAIM-B010, CLAIM-B011).
why_not_proved: SpinGroup carries no smooth structure (OP-001), so there is no ambient notion of its Lie algebra in the pinned Mathlib for this group; an exponential-free intrinsic substitute inside Cl3 has not been constructed or related to gB.
prerequisites: the existing Lie algebra gB / gBLie (CLAIM-L011)
OP-001 or an intrinsic generator space inside Cl3
suggested_next_test: Construct an intrinsic generator space for SpinGroup inside Cl3 and prove that its induced action on the paravector image of the carrier lands in gB, giving a project-native substitute for d-rho-e.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not import conventional Lie(Spin(1,3)) results as if they were formalized here, and do not assert the identification on the strength of the dimension count alone.
